work.description: Fully read LF5924–6125 plus 20 literal LF of outside context, using split('\n') only. Actual Leo XII source issuer at LF5933; full Latin body and own closing consistent. CLXXXVIII has all §§1–5 and complete 9 January 1827 dating. Native leaf45 left LF5924–5987 continues right at LF5990 (seplembris ejusdem anni...), then leaf46 left LF6065 completes maximum nosocomium from LF6053; the remaining disposition, derogation and dating end LF6125. Running title and page number LF6059/6062 occur before that left-column continuation and do not reverse its substantive text.  Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
